_about: APPROVED by the owner 2026-11-09 (framework RIGHTS-1 / RIGHTS-1.6, NAMING-PROGRAMME-1 phase 1, owner 2026-11-09). The ONE machine-readable list of every right each SecurityInsight managed identity id-si-<role> must HOLD, built feature by feature and validated against the code (use side = the code path that needs the right; grant side = the setup / updater code that grants it today). ADD-ONLY: nothing in this file proposes a removal; 'granted-but-unused' rows are kept and only flagged (owner 2026-11-09: 'i have not approved any removal of graph rights'). Not yet read by any installer, updater or check -- that wiring is NAMING-PROGRAMME-1 phase 2. Paths are relative to SOLUTIONS/SecurityInsight. Review sheet: docs/RIGHTS-REVIEW-DRAFT.md.
ownerApproval: owner 2026-11-09, Invardia rights review: approved (incl. broad) -- his pick 'Approve all incl. broad' (relayed by Invardia ~10:20Z): every granted, conditional and MISSING line incl. the updater's broad rights as standing rights; the granted-but-unused lines stay (reported, never removed)

statusValues.validated: a code path uses it and setup / the updater grants it
statusValues.granted-but-unused: granted somewhere, no use found in the code -- KEEP it, flagged only, never removed
statusValues.used-but-not-granted: MISSING: a code path uses it and nothing grants it (or grants it only on some install paths -- see 'gap')
statusValues.conditional: needed only when an opt-in feature is on; the grant path exists but is opt-in
statusValues.refused: REFUSED for SecurityInsight (framework G5): never granted by any path -- no installer, updater, support script or identity move; the refusal is the STATUS, never only a note (setup/_shared/SI-DbInitJob.ps1 Get-SIDbInitRefusedGraphRoleNames is the one list)

resourceApps._appRoleIds: Graph / Defender app role ids are read BY VALUE from the resource's service principal at run time (setup/Grant-SIIdentity.ps1, setup/_shared/SI-DbInitJob.ps1 Resolve-SIDbInitUpdaterGraphRoles); an id is written here only where SI code carries it.

scopePatterns.secret-vaults: each Key Vault that holds the Shodan key, the Azure OpenAI key, the SMTP password or the licence (SI-License) -- one grant per vault; normally the install vault
scopePatterns.dcr-rg: the resource group of SI's data collection rules / endpoint
scopePatterns.defender-workspace: the Defender / Sentinel workspace, when it is not the SI workspace
scopePatterns.reader-scopes: the collection scope(s): default the install's subscription; a management group or the tenant root when the customer chose that (setup/_shared/SI-GuidedInstall.ps1 Get-SIInstallReaderScopes)
scopePatterns.tagging-scopes: where Azure tags may be written: -TaggingScopes, default the reader scopes
scopePatterns.tenant: the Entra tenant (an application permission is tenant-wide)
scopePatterns.sender-mailbox: the shared mailbox SI sends as (SI_Mail_From), through the Exchange management scope '<MailboxName>-Sender'
scopePatterns.sqldb-si-pro: the Pro database (cfg, sidata, vuln, cmdbsync, snowstage schemas)
scopePatterns.support-dbs: every OTHER product database that holds cfg.SupportConsent
scopePatterns.sql-admin-group: the SQL server's Entra admin group (grp-si-sql-admins, or the customer's own group)
scopePatterns.signin-app: the web app's sign-in app registration (AzureAd__ClientId)
scopePatterns.customer-key: the customer-managed key in the customer's Key Vault (key scope)

identities.runs: every caj-si-* pipeline job (producers / workers, publicip, risk-analysis(-detailed), asset-trend, -correlation, -vulnerabilities, -datasync, -cmdb-sql, templates, flow, config-backup, verification, heartbeat, close-loop mail, data-out) and the image pull of caj-si-dbinit / caj-si-supportsql
